name: Dumbbell curl ladder
description: Climb from light to moderate curls, one set at each weight.

name: Slow eccentric curls
description: Lower each curl over four counts. Keep the elbows still.

name: Heavy barbell curls
description: Work up to a challenging set of moderate reps.
caution: Heavy curls can strain the elbows and lower back. Keep your back neutral and stop if you feel sharp elbow pain.

name: Chair-supported curls
description: Seated curls with light weight. Easy and steady.

name: Hammer curl flow
description: Hammer curls alternating arms in a relaxed rhythm.

name: Band curl burnout
description: Fast band curls in short sets with minimal rest.
caution: Keep the reps controlled. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

name: Concentration curl pause
description: One arm at a time, with a one-second pause at the top of each curl.

name: Towel isometric holds
description: Hold a towel curl position to build tension without moving much.

name: Incline curl stretch
description: Lie on an incline bench and curl slowly to feel a deep stretch.

name: Drag curls
description: Keep the bar close and pull the elbows back as you curl.

name: Zottman curls
description: Curl up with palms facing up, rotate at the top, and lower with palms facing down.

name: Quick cable curls
description: Easy cable curls with light weight. Just get moving.

name: Pump set finisher
description: Many light-to-moderate reps with short rests.
caution: High-rep pump work can build fatigue. Pause and shake out your arms if you feel sharp pain.
